First output your verdict, then a brief explanation.

Format: VERDICT: <TRUE|FALSE|UNCLEAR>
REASON: <one sentence explaining why>

responses.raw:

The question asks to fill in: "Bien que nous ___ fatigués, nous avons continué."

Analysis completed:
- A. "ayons été" (MARKED CORRECT) - passé composé subjunctive of être with nous - CORRECT because "bien que" requires subjunctive
- B. "avons été" - passé composé indicative - INCORRECT (wrong mood)
- C. "soyons été" - grammatically invalid (can't combine être subjunctive present with past participle)
- D. "ayons être" - grammatically invalid (can't put infinitive after conjugated avoir)
